name: cloudflare
summary: Scoped Cloudflare API token minted per profile from a long-lived minter token

secrets.prompt: Cloudflare minter token (needs permission to create API tokens)

config.help: Names one entry in the profiles map in cloudflare.js. Set on BOTH the proxy and the broker, to the same value — the proxy injects for it, the broker refuses to mint anything else. The lab container does not get to choose: one profile per deployment, so two privilege levels means two deployments.
